angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 619,173 km at 67.20 pc = 0.12 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 14.8818 +/- 0.0098 mas (same row, RUWE 0.88): 67.20 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.89 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Rodrigues et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-512 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.237R/abstract): 619,173 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.74 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Rodrigues et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-512 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.237R/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5277 +/- 67 K from Rodrigues et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-512 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.237R/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Rodrigues et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-512 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.237R/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-512.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.409, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-512 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.11 dex, from Rodrigues et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.237R/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-512 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.25696, from Rodrigues et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.237R/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-512 (pscomppars): age 8.235 Gyr, from Rodrigues et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.237R/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-512 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.63 km/s, from Rodrigues et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.237R/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
